Long Haul

Titik Redispatch

A designated waypoint or position along the route after which flight dispatch is revalidated or amended based on updated operational or weather conditions.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Titik Redispatch?

In this glossary, Titik Redispatch refers to: A designated waypoint or position along the route after which flight dispatch is revalidated or amended based on updated operational or weather conditions.

How is Titik Redispatch used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Di titik redispatch Delta, kru menerima izin untuk melanjutkan ke tujuan utama berdasarkan cuaca yang membaik."

Definition

A designated waypoint or position along the route after which flight dispatch is revalidated or amended based on updated operational or weather conditions.

Operational example

At redispatch point Delta, crew received clearance to continue to primary destination based on improved weather.
